table.retrieve:
select 
	Code=P.PatientCode, 
	Reg_No=P.RegNo, 
	Active=P.Active, 
	Name=P.Name, 
	Gender=P.Gender, 
	Birth_Date = CONVERT(Varchar(100), P.DOB, 103), 
	Father_Name=P.FName, 
	Profession=P.Profession, 
	Mother_Name=P.MotherName, 
	Profession2=P.Profession2, 
	MembershipID=P.MembershipID,
	FamilyMembers=P.FamilyMembers, 
	Brothers=P.Brothers, 
	Sisters=P.Sisters, 
	Date= CONVERT(Varchar(100), P.Date, 103),
	Customer_Name = A.Name, 
	User_Name = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE P.UserCode = U.UserCode), 
	Created_By=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=P.CreatedBy), 
	InActived_By = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode=P.InActivedBy), 
	Address1 = P.Address1, 
	Address2 = P.Address2, 
	Address3 = P.Address3, 
	National_ID_Card = P.NationalIDCard, 
	City=P.City, 
	Phone=P.Phone, 
	Phone2=P.Phone2, 
	MobileNo1=P.MobileNo1, 
	MobileNo2=P.MobileNo2, 
	MobileNo3=P.MobileNo3, 
	Fax=P.Fax, 
	Email=P.Email, 
	WARD=P.Ward, 
	Rank = (SELECT R.Name FROM Rank R WHERE P.RankCode=R.RankCode),
	Unit = (SELECT U.Name FROM Unit U WHERE P.UnitCode=U.UnitCode), 
	Original_Date=CONVERT(Varchar(100), P.OriginalDate, 103),
	Inactive_Date=CONVERT(Varchar(100), P.InactiveDate, 103), 
	Relation=(SELECT R.Name FROM Relation R WHERE P.RelationCode=R.RelationCode), 
	Doctor_Name=(SELECT D.Name FROM Doctors D WHERE P.DoctCode=D.DoctCode), 
	Ward_Name=(SELECT W.Name FROM Ward W WHERE P.WardCode=W.WardCode), 
	Employee_Name=P.EmployeeName, 
	Disease = (SELECT D.Name FROM Disease D WHERE P.DiseaseCode=D.DiseaseCode),  
	Location = (SELECT PL.Name FROM PatientLocation PL WHERE P.LocationCode=PL.LocationCode), 
	Diagnosis=P.Diagnosis, 
	InActive_Count=CAST(P.InActiveCount as VARCHAR(10)), 
	Recurring_Period=CAST(P.RecurringPeriod AS VARCHAR(200)), 
	Category = (SELECT PC.Name FROM PatientCategory PC WHERE PC.PatientCatCode=P.PatientCatCode), 
	Reference=P.Reference, 
	Gestation=(SELECT G.Name FROM Gestation G WHERE G.GestationCode = P.GestationCode), 
	Credit_Limit=CAST(P.CrLimit AS VARCHAR(15)), 
	RefNo1=P.RefNo1, 
	RefNo2=P.RefNo2, 
	RefNo3=P.RefNo3, 
	RefNo4=P.RefNo4,
	RefNo5=P.RefNo5, 
	RefNo6=P.RefNo6, 
	RefNo7=P.RefNo7, 
	Institute=P.Institute, 
	Nationality=P.Nationality,
	Passport_No=P.PassportNo
FROM 
	Patient P, Accounts A
WHERE 
	P.CustCode = A.AccCode
